name: smwmusic-mario-s-time-machine-snes-unfinished-time-period
title: Mario's Time Machine (SNES) - Unfinished Time Period
description:
A song played when you exit a time period without completing it.

Can be used for a sad cutscene or a game over.

Edit: Updated to use GAIN remote commands instead of ADSR ones because it wasn't being processed in game.
